0.original: Totonowa believes you are ready to join a guildhest.

1.original: Guildhests are special operations organized by Adventurers' Guilds and overseen by battlewardens. To learn more about what guildhests entail, speak with Battlewarden Lost Rabbit.

2.original: Battlewarden Lost Rabbit explains that guildhests will test your ability to work with others to achieve a common goal. Unless you are content to conduct your adventures forever alone, it may be in your best interests to participate in these operations at least once.

48.original: While I heartily encourage you to partake of my guildleves, should you seek a different sort of challenge, you might also consider joining a guildhest.

49.original: If you wish to know more, pray speak with Battlewarden Lost Rabbit. I will inform her of your success against the peiste so that there are no doubts as to your abilities.

50.original: You needn't say a word, adventurer. I could hear Totonowa quite well from here.

51.original: As this would be your first time joining us, allow me a moment to explain in detail just what exactly a guildhest entails.

52.original: More than a simple levequest, but not quite as realm-shaking as a Grand Company outing, guildhests will test your ability to work together with a small party of battle companions to overcome not-so-small obstacles.

53.original: The duty is taxing, but the coin is decent, and you will be helping maintain the safety of Eorzea and the well-being of her citizens.

54.original: If what I described appeals to you, pray speak to me again to join a guildhest.

55.original: You have unlocked the Duty Finder! This feature allows you to undertake multiplayer duties without having to form a party on your own.

56.original: To bring up the Duty Finder interface, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty Finder<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> under <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>main menu<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
